title: 第3章 三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “哈哈哈哈，开个玩笑，东西还我，这玩意儿是我走之前顺排长的。”“啥？顺回来的？”“这有啥的，还有人把连长体能服，袜子，裤衩子给顺走了。哈哈哈哈，想想也挺逗.....”“都是人才......”“走走走，正好周末，哥带你去体育场提前感受一下，入伍后的体验。”堂哥立马从床上爬起，刷牙洗漱后，穿上那件从部队带回来的灰色体能体恤和短裤，开车带着陆阳直奔体育场。周末早上的体育场人很多，大多是中老年人，也有年轻人在打篮球。陆林准备趁着周末休息，带着自已这个弱不禁风的堂弟提前感受感受部队的艰苦。“引体向上，能拉几个？”“一两个吧。”陆阳很诚实，他目前的水平，只能拉这么多。事实上绝大多数高中生，因长期缺乏锻炼，身体素质比他好不到哪儿去。堂哥摇摇手指：“部队引体向上是必练科目，起码能拉十二个才算合格。上去，拉两个我看看。”陆阳作为新手小白，什么都不懂，自是然立马听话照做。只见他双腿下蹲，起跳后抓住单杠，使出吃奶得劲才让下巴勉强越过单杠。但这第一个却是借助上跳的那股冲劲蒙混过去的，等到第二个立马就露了怯，死活上不去。堂哥为他做示范，来到一旁抓住单杠后，连续做了七八个标准引体，落下也只是稍微有点儿喘气。“不行了，退伍好多年，太久没锻炼了。”“老弟啊，照你这样的方式，到明年也拉不上去。”“我教你个办法，想练引体先练吊杠。在心里默数，能挂在杠上六十秒不掉下来，第一步就算成功了......”堂哥让他先练挂杠，挂着挂着，胳膊力量自然就有了。然后再尝试做引体向上，绝对水到渠成，事半功倍。这是当年他刚进部队时，他班长教他的，还是用背包绳给他双手绑在单杠上那种。像是晾面条那样挂了一晚上，第二天莫名其妙的单杠就能拉上去了，简直不要太神奇。陆阳听得汗毛都立起来了，为了入伍后不遭受同样待遇，他立马就按照堂哥交代的那样，开始练习吊杆。因为手上没有抓握力，最开始十秒都坚持不到。可多练几次后，陆阳发现自已的抓握力似乎增加了。慢慢的，竟然能够坚持到十五秒，二十秒，甚至最长能坚持到三十多秒不撒手。【检测到宿主已入军籍，“知识就是力量”系统正在绑定！】【本系统致力于将宿主打造成全能兵王，当宿主学习到部队相关知识，或认真阅读优质书籍时，便可触发系统能力提升身体各项机能！】陆阳大喜过望，没想到自已竟有一天也能绑定系统。果然，金手指是重生者的标配！【检测到新知识点：吊杠！】【知识点分析：物理性的将人吊在单杠上，训练过程中可对臂力，抓握力，耐力提供x2倍速提升！】原来是这么个，知识就是力量？了解，学习，并掌握！这设定，有点儿意思！在搞清楚系统的作用后，陆阳开始新一轮尝试。这次，他明显感觉到胳膊和手腕的抓握力，得到些许增强。在单杠上停留的时间也从原来的不到二十秒，轻轻松松就超过了三十秒。但越是往后就越困难，因为系统只提供双倍返还，并不能够替他减轻在训练中吃得苦。但陆阳很喜欢这种，一份付出双倍回报的感觉，就像是开了个流量加速包。在陆阳一次次的坚持下，慢慢的终于能够如堂哥说的那样，能够在单杠上挂足六十秒。但，仅仅只是一个六十秒明显是不够的，需要很多个六十秒的吊杠叠加在一起。陆阳像是晒面条那样，完成了不知道多少个六十秒吊杆。双臂酸胀的厉害，但却莫名感觉手臂力量得到了些许增强。他甩了甩胳膊简单放松了一下，接着便再度起跳，重新尝试引体向上。这一次，果然要比最开始的时候轻松的多，身体也不在如那般抖个不停。果然吊杠是有效果的，这可是实打实的干货，就跟在训练上走捷径似的。“一个！”“两个！”“三...个！”“四，四.....再来一个啊！”陆阳艰难的将下巴，一次又一次高于单杠。正在边上篮球场，和朋友打球的堂哥都看愣住了。他虽然教会了陆阳一些能够快速拉杠的小技巧，但起码得吊个一两天才能有成效。怎么，这才过去几个小时，一下子就能干四五个上去了？“大林子，那小子你认识？”“我堂弟，马上要去当兵了，我带他来练练。”“哎哟我去，你不早说？战友战友亲如兄弟，你堂弟就是我们堂弟。走走走，咱们几个退伍老班长，过去给人指点指点！”几个退伍老兵干脆也不再打篮球，全都像是围观大熊猫那样， 色眯眯的盯着陆阳。尤其，中间还有个戴眼镜的圆脸络腮胡，看得陆阳鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。“歇会儿吧，给你介绍一下。杰哥，大宏，都是退伍老兵。”“首长好。”陆阳从杠上下来，礼貌的喊了一声。这声“首长”喊得这俩退伍老兵心花怒放，神采飞扬的。他俩一个和堂哥是同龄兵退伍，另一个才是一期士官，在部队里顶多被新兵称呼班长。至于首长这两个字，得是正儿八经的上尉及以上军衔的军官才有资格被喊。就这么一瞬间，二人就对陆阳这个准新兵的好感值迅速拉满。干脆球也不打了，纷纷传授起了他们在部队里的经验技巧。正所谓，三个臭皮匠，赛过诸葛亮。虽说他们在部队里并不出类拔萃，但细节上的东西还是知道不少的。接下来的时间，陆阳就像是金庸武侠里拜师江南七怪的杨过一样，开始接受三人全方位的指导。而陆阳耳边的提示音，也像脑中似的“叮叮叮”的响个不停，因为对于他而言部队的一切都是新鲜的。所以，这些全都是新知识点，都是能够帮助提升身体各项属性的关键。从引体向上，俯卧撑，到双杠臂屈伸，再到蹲姿训练，正步，以及三公里跑。虽说只是教个皮毛，但陆阳的积极配合，还有听话的态度，也让这些退伍老兵在离开绿营许多年后，重新找回当初在部队时的那种感觉。虽然身材走形，再也穿不上原本的军装和常服；虽然被生活和工作压弯了腰，但心中那股曾经身为军人的骄傲，从未消失。时隔多年，他们也终于在陆阳这个准新兵身上，再次重温当兵时的快乐。而那里，也是他们无数次在梦里想回，却又回不去的地方......
content_en: "Hahahaha, just kidding, give me back the stuff. This thing was given to me by the platoon leader before I left." "What? It was brought back?" "There's something like this. Someone also took away the company commander's fitness uniform, socks, and underpants. Hahahaha, it's funny to think about it..." "They are all talents...." "Let's go, it's the weekend.I'll take you to the stadium to experience the experience after joining the army." My cousin immediately got up from the bed, brushed his teeth and washed, put on the gray physical fitness shirt and shorts he brought back from the army, and drove Lu Yang straight to the stadium.There are many people in the stadium on weekend mornings, mostly middle-aged and elderly people, but there are also young people playing basketball.Lu Lin planned to take advantage of the weekend to rest and take his fragile cousin to experience the hardships of the army in advance."How many pull-ups can you pull?" "One or two." Lu Yang was honest. With his current level, he could only pull so many pull-ups.In fact, most high school students' physical fitness is not much better than his due to long-term lack of exercise.The cousin shook his finger: "Pull-ups are a required subject for the army. You must be able to do at least twelve pull-ups to be considered qualified. Go up and pull up two and let me see." Lu Yang, as a newbie, didn't understand anything, so he immediately obeyed and obeyed.I saw him squatting down with both legs, grabbing the horizontal bar after taking off, and using all his strength to barely get his chin over the horizontal bar.But the first one was able to get past it with the help of the momentum of jumping up. The second one immediately became timid and couldn't get up.His cousin gave him a demonstration. After he came to the side and grabbed the horizontal bar, he did seven or eight standard pull-ups in a row. He was only slightly out of breath when he fell down."No, I've been out of the army for many years, and I haven't exercised for too long." "Brother, with the way you are doing, you won't be able to pull up next year." "I'll teach you a way, if you want to practice pull-ups, practice the hanging bar first. Count silently in your mind, if you can hang on the bar for 60 seconds without falling off, the first step is considered a success..." His cousin asked him to practice hanging on the bar first, and his arm strength will naturally develop.Then try to do pull-ups, it will definitely come naturally and get twice the result with half the effort.This was what his squad leader taught him when he first joined the army. He tied his hands to the horizontal bar with a backpack rope.It was like hanging noodles to dry all night, and the horizontal bar was somehow able to be pulled up the next day. It's not amazing at all.Lu Yang's hair stood up when he heard this. In order not to suffer the same treatment after joining the army, he immediately started practicing the boom as his cousin told him.Because I had no grip on my hands, I couldn't hold on for the first ten seconds.But after practicing a few more times, Lu Yang found that his grip seemed to have increased.Slowly, I was able to hold on for fifteen seconds, twenty seconds, and even the longest period of more than thirty seconds without letting go.[It has been detected that the host has enlisted in the military, and the "Knowledge is Power" system is being bound!】【This system is dedicated to building the host into an all-around military king. When the host learns knowledge about the army or carefully reads high-quality books, the system's abilities can be triggered to improve various body functions!】Lu Yang was overjoyed. He didn't expect that one day he would be able to bind to the system.Sure enough, golden fingers are standard equipment for reborn people![New knowledge point detected: hanging bar!][Knowledge point analysis: Physically hanging people on the horizontal bar can increase arm strength, grip strength, and endurance by x2 times during training!] So it turns out that knowledge is power?Understand, learn, and master!This setting is a bit interesting!After figuring out the function of the system, Lu Yang started a new round of attempts.This time, he clearly felt that the grip on his arms and wrists had been slightly enhanced.The time spent on the horizontal bar also went from less than twenty seconds to easily over thirty seconds.But the further back he goes, the more difficult it becomes, because the system only provides double rebates, which cannot relieve him of the hardships he endures in training.But Lu Yang liked this very much, the feeling of getting double the reward for his efforts, just like opening a traffic acceleration package.With Lu Yang's persistence again and again, he was finally able to hang on the horizontal bar for a full sixty seconds just as his cousin said.However, just one sixty-second bar is obviously not enough. It requires many sixty-second hanging bars superimposed on each other.Lu Yang completed countless sixty-second booms like he was drying noodles.My arms were sore and swollen, but I felt that my arm strength had been slightly enhanced.He shook his arms to relax briefly, then took off again and tried pull-ups again.This time, it was indeed much easier than at the beginning, and my body was no longer shaking like that.Sure enough, the hanging bar is effective. This is real practical information, just like taking a shortcut in training."One!" "Two!" "Three...one!" "Four, four...one more!" Lu Yang struggled to raise his chin higher than the horizontal bar again and again.My cousin, who was playing with his friends on the basketball court nearby, was stunned.Although he taught Lu Yang some tricks to pull the bar quickly, it would take at least a day or two to be effective.Why, it's only been a few hours, and you can do four or five in one go?"Da Linzi, do you know that guy?" "My cousin is going to join the army soon. I'll bring him to practice." "Oh, I'm going, didn't you tell me earlier? Comrades-in-arms are as close as brothers, and your cousin is our cousin. Let's go, let's go over and give some advice to others!" Several veterans simply stopped playing basketball, and they all looked at Lu Yang like they were watching giant pandas.In particular, there was a round-faced man wearing glasses and a beard in the middle, which made Lu Yang's skin crawl."Let's take a break and let me introduce you. Brother Jie and Dahong are all veterans." "Hello, chief." Lu Yang got off the pole and called out politely.The shout of "chief" made the two veterans feel elated and in high spirits.One of them and his cousin retired from the army at the same age, and the other was a first-term non-commissioned officer. In the army, he was called squad leader by new recruits at most.As for the word "chief", only a serious officer with the rank of captain or above is qualified to be called "chief".In just such an instant, the two of them quickly gained a good impression of Lu Yang, a would-be recruit.They simply stopped playing and taught them their experience and skills in the army.As the saying goes, three cobblers are better than Zhuge Liang.Although they are not outstanding in the army, they still know a lot of details.In the following time, Lu Yang was like Yang Guo who was apprenticed to the Seven Monsters of Jiangnan in Jin Yong's martial arts, and began to receive all-round guidance from the three of them.And the notification sounds in Lu Yang's ears were like a "ding-ding-ding" ringing in his head, because everything in the army was new to him.Therefore, these are all new knowledge points, and they are all keys that can help improve various attributes of the body.From pull-ups, push-ups, to parallel bar dips, to squat training, goose steps, and three-kilometer runs.Although it was just a superficial lesson, Lu Yang's active cooperation and obedient attitude allowed these veterans to regain the same feeling they had when they were in the army many years after leaving Green Camp.Although he was out of shape and could no longer fit into his original military and regular uniforms; although he was bent down by life and work, the pride of being a soldier never disappeared.After many years, they finally relived the joy of being a soldier through Lu Yang, a quasi-recruit.And there, it was also the place they wanted to go back to in their dreams countless times, but could not go back...
